clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, Prairie Wolf Paws are gathered from the wolves that hunt the plains. Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village uses them with plainstrider talons to make a cleansing totem.

Prairie wolves hunt in packs across Mulgore’s rolling grasses, alongside prairie stalkers and their pack alphas. They threaten young hunters and local livestock, and their place in the spiritual balance of the plains matters to tauren shamans. The shamans see the paws as more than trophies: they carry the land’s innate vitality.

When goblin ventures tainted Mulgore’s sacred water reserves, shaman Mull Thunderhorn needed the land’s physical aid against the pollution. Joined with plainstrider talons, wolf paws provide the spiritual resonance for cleansing totems. With one made, the work of purifying the Winterhoof Water Well can begin.
